home.title: schul-dashboard — the school week, in one place
home.description: Homework, timetable changes and announcements for your whole class, kept up to date together. Free, without ads, made by students.

features.title: Features
features.description: Tasks, timetable, announcements, chat, groups and a private space — everything schul-dashboard does, in detail.

about.title: About
about.description: schul-dashboard is built by students in Berlin. Why we started, and what we won't compromise on.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Questions, bugs, ideas — write to us.

hero.title: The school week, {emphasis}
hero.lede: Homework, timetable changes and announcements for your whole class — kept up to date together, visible to everyone the moment they change.
hero.timetable_label: Example timetable for class 10b: a cancelled German lesson on Monday, a room change on Tuesday, a substitute on Wednesday and an exam on Thursday.
hero.caption: Class 10b, week 39. Cancellations, room changes and substitutes show up in everyone's timetable as soon as they're entered.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.title: Homework gets written down once. {emphasis} has it.
tasks.body: Anyone your class trusts can add homework, exams and Dalton assignments — with a due date, a description and a photo of the board or the worksheet. Everyone ticks tasks off for themselves.

changes.label: Timetable
changes.title: Cancelled, moved, covered — {emphasis}
changes.body: Save the courses you take and your timetable shows only your lessons. Substitutes, room changes and cancellations are marked in the lesson they affect, and your next lesson waits on your dashboard.

items.substitute: Mr Weber covers for Ms Adler

changes.announcement: Because of the heat, lessons on Friday end after period 4.
changes.announcement_caption: Announcements stay at the top of the app for every member until an admin takes them down.

groups.label: Groups
groups.title: One person keeps it up to date; the whole class has it.
groups.thirty: classmates have it on their phone.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.body: Members, moderators and admins. Each group decides who may add tasks, edit the timetable, post announcements or moderate the chat.

invites.title: Invite links
invites.body: Send one link and your classmates are in. Links expire on their own, and admins can revoke them at any time.

many.title: More than one group
many.body: Your class, your advanced courses, your club — each with its own tasks and timetable, one switch apart.

extras.label: Also included
extras.title: And the things you'd miss if they weren't there.

chat.title: Group chat
chat.body: Talk to your class without a separate messenger. Reply to a message, see who's typing — and nobody needs anyone's phone number.

private.title: Private notes
private.body: Your own to-do list next to the class's. Encrypted with AES-256 and visible only to you.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: Jump to any page or action from the keyboard: create a task, switch groups or invite someone without reaching for the mouse.

devices.title: On every device
devices.body: Runs in any browser on phones, tablets and laptops. Nothing to install, and what you tick off on one device is ticked off on all of them.

principles.label: Why
principles.lead: schul-dashboard is made by students in Berlin, because the tools our schools gave us weren't good enough.
principles.rest: It's free, it shows no ads, and it doesn't sell anyone's data. That isn't a launch offer — it's the point.

features.title: Everything {name} {emphasis}
features.lede: A complete tour of the app. Each part is short on purpose — schul-dashboard is meant to be understood without a manual.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: Homework, exams and Dalton assignments for the whole group live in one list. Someone adds a task once — subject, due date, description, attachments — and everyone has it. If the same subject already has an entry for that day, you're asked before a duplicate appears.
items: Homework, exams and Dalton, filterable by type and subject
Photos, PDFs and Office files on any task
Tick off for yourself, without affecting anyone else
Pin what matters; past tasks move to the archive

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.body: Admins build the timetable once in a visual editor: lessons, rooms, breaks and courses. Save the courses you take and you only see your own lessons. Substitutes, room changes and cancellations are entered live and show up immediately for everyone they affect.
items: Week view on desktop, one day at a time on phones
Only the courses you take
Cancellations, substitutes and room changes
The next lesson, right on your dashboard

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.body: Admins post a short notice — a school trip, an early finish, a moved exam — and it appears at the top of the app for every member. Anyone who hasn't read it yet gets a notification.
items: Shown to every member at once
Three levels: info, warning and important
Several at once, one tap apart
Notifications for unread announcements

chat.title: Group chat
chat.body: Every group has its own chat, so homework no longer drowns in a messenger group. Members appear under generated aliases, so nobody has to share their phone number.
items: Replies to individual messages
See who's typing
Copy, report and delete messages
Choose which roles may write

groups.title: Groups and roles
groups.body: A group is a class, a course or a club. Whoever creates it owns it and decides what members, moderators and admins may do. Standard groups suit grades 1 to 10; Abitur groups manage whole year groups with basic and advanced courses.
items: Invite links that expire and can be revoked
Roles with fine-grained permissions
Subjects, courses and a timetable editor
Remove and ban members
Abitur groups with GK and LK courses
Dalton as an optional group setting

private.title: Private space
private.body: A to-do list that belongs to you alone — shopping, training, the book you promised to finish. Private tasks are encrypted, and only your password unlocks them; not even your group's admins can see them.
items: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM
Visible only to you
Drag to reorder, edit and duplicate
Tick off when done

search.title: Search and shortcuts
search.body: Press Ctrl K (⌘ K on a Mac) anywhere in the app to open quick search. Type a few letters to jump to a page or start an action — no clicking through menus.
items: Open with Ctrl K or ⌘ K
Pages, settings and actions
Alt N for a new task, Alt P for a private one
Ctrl G to switch groups

account.title: Account and security
account.body: Your account is protected by a verified email address, optional two-factor authentication and an overview of every device you're signed in on. If you want to leave, you delete your account yourself — no request, no waiting.
items: Email verification
Two-factor authentication with any authenticator app
Sign in with Google
See and end active sessions
Reset a forgotten password by email
Delete your account at any time

about.title: Made by students {emphasis}
about.lede: schul-dashboard is a private project run by students in Berlin. We built the tool we were missing at school, and we use it every day.

story.label: Story
story.lead: Homework got lost in a messenger group. Cancelled lessons were news at the classroom door.
story.body: So we built what we were missing: one place where homework, exams and timetable changes are written down once and everyone can see them. It has grown one real need at a time — invite links, roles and permissions, a timetable editor, courses for Abitur year groups, Dalton support. Nothing was added because it looked good on a feature list.

free.title: Free, without ads
free.body: No subscriptions, no premium tier, no advertising. Everyone gets the whole product, and that won't change.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Personal data is encrypted. We don't sell data, we don't show ads, and we don't collect more than the service needs to run.

students.title: By students
students.body: We're students ourselves and use schul-dashboard every day, so we build what we actually need — not what sounds good in a sales pitch.

simple.title: Only what helps
simple.body: Every feature has to solve a real problem at school. Whatever doesn't gets cut.

team.label: Team
team.body: schul-dashboard is built and run by a small group of students in Berlin, in our free time and with no company behind it. Want to help or have an idea? Write to us — we're happy to hear from you.

contact.title: Write {emphasis}
contact.lede: Questions, bugs, ideas for new features — we read everything and reply as soon as we can.

discord.title: Discord
discord.body: Talk to other users, share ideas and reach us directly.

status.title: System status
status.body: See whether something is down before you write to us.

bugs.title: Found a bug?
bugs.body: Email us what you did, what you expected and what happened instead. A screenshot helps.

not_found.title: Free period.
not_found.body: This page doesn't exist — or it was cancelled.

cookie.text: We only use cookies the site needs to work — no tracking.

footer.tagline: The school week, in one place. Free and without ads, made by students.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How schul-dashboard handles your personal data.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it.

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.text: The data controller responsible for this service is schul-dashboard, reachable at contact{'@'}schul-dashboard.com.

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
dataCollected.item0: Email address (for account creation and verification)
dataCollected.item1: Username (randomly generated to protect your identity in groups)
dataCollected.item2: Usage data necessary to provide the service (tasks, schedule, group memberships)

purpose.title: Purpose of Processing
purpose.text: We collect and process your data solely to provide and improve the schul-dashboard service. We do not sell data to third parties and do not use it for advertising purposes.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.text: Your data is stored for as long as your account exists. You can delete your account at any time, after which your data will be permanently removed.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.intro: Under applicable data protection law, you have the following rights:
rights.item0: Right of access to your personal data
rights.item1: Right to rectification of inaccurate data
rights.item2: Right to erasure of your data
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at contact{'@'}schul-dashboard.com.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use only technically necessary cookies — for session management, language preference, and color mode. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

security.title: Security
security.text: Personal data is protected using industry-standard encryption (AES-256-GCM). We use HTTPS throughout and employ CSRF protection and two-factor authentication options to secure your account.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or in-app notification.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By using schul-dashboard, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the service.

service.title: The Service
service.text: schul-dashboard provides a free, web-based school management platform. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue features at any time, with notice where possible.

account.title: Your Account
account.item0: You must provide a valid email address to create an account.
account.item1: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure.
account.item2: You must be at least 13 years old to use this service.
account.item3: One account per person. Do not share accounts.

conduct.title: Acceptable Use
conduct.intro: You agree not to use schul-dashboard to:
conduct.item0: Upload or share illegal, harmful, or abusive content.
conduct.item1: Attempt to gain unauthorised access to other accounts or systems.
conduct.item2: Interfere with the service or its infrastructure.
conduct.item3: Use the service for commercial purposes without prior written consent.

termination.title: Termination
termination.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.text: schul-dashboard is provided as-is. We make no guarantees of uptime or data permanence. We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from use of the service.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
